table.name: GreaterManchesterCrime
table.purpose: Records of individual crimes reported in Greater Manchester during August 2018, with location, crime category and investigation outcome (UK police street-level crime data, as published via data.police.uk).

col_001.name: crime_id
col_001.description: Unique identifier for each recorded crime. Values are 12-hex-digit strings formatted like MAC addresses (e.g. 00:08:EE:1A:EC:80); this is the standard anonymised ID format used in UK police street crime data. Primary key, one value per row.

col_002.name: month_or_reported_timestamp
col_002.description: Timestamp of the crime record, ranging 2018-08-01 to 2018-08-30, so effectively the date the crime occurred or was recorded during August 2018. The exact semantics (occurrence vs. reporting time) cannot be distinguished from the data alone.

col_003.name: location
col_003.description: Approximate street-level location of the crime, phrased as 'On or near <street/landmark>' (e.g. 'On or near Parking Area', 'On or near Heron Drive'), as used in UK police street crime data to anonymise exact locations.

col_004.name: lsoa_code_and_name
col_004.description: Lower Layer Super Output Area (LSOA) of the crime, given as '<district> <code>' (e.g. 'Manchester 055B', 'Bolton 035C'). These are ONS census geography codes for Greater Manchester districts.

col_005.name: crime_type
col_005.description: Crime category, one of 13 UK police crime classifications (e.g. 'Violence and sexual offences', 'Public order', 'Burglary').

col_006.name: outcome_status
col_006.description: Investigation outcome for the crime, one of the standard UK police outcome descriptions (e.g. 'Investigation complete; no suspect identified', 'Under investigation', 'Offender given a caution').
